description: Hire a live vetted human expert for help with a task. The expert joins a real-time session (chat or video) and works the problem with you. Sessions draw on the connected account's LIVEAIHELP minute balance. If no expert is online you are placed in a FIFO holding queue — poll check_queue until matched. Chat mode is recommended for AI agents.

topic.description: What you need help with. Be specific — this is shown to the expert.
